entities.summary: Gotō Toshio, known by his pen name Hayashi Fusao , was a Japanese novelist and literary critic in Shōwa period Japan. He is known for his early works in the proletarian literature movement, although he later became an ultranationalist. He also used the alias Shirai Akira.
